name: Gapless Player
description: Gapless Web Audio playback for eligible audio queues in the web client. The stock HTML audio player remains the fallback.
overview: Gapless Web Audio playback for eligible audio queues.

versions.changelog: Gapless Web Audio playback for eligible audio queues. Injects into the stock web client in-memory (no web-root writes); now-playing-bar on/off toggle; download progress in the seek bar while a track loads; optional now-playing browser notifications (plugin setting); repeat and shuffle; seek and unpause near the end of a track start immediately; accurate playback reporting (every track start is paired with one stop at the right position, so played marks, resume points and scrobbling are correct, also on album switches and stop); pause takes effect while a track is still loading; pause, seek, skip and play-next keep working while the browser resumes audio after a background interruption (mobile); graceful fallback to the normal player for undecodable tracks, also when skipping or resuming; strips leading ID3 tags so tagged FLAC decodes gaplessly. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 or later.
